blocks.text: «**The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ.**»
So the nominative plural and the genitive singular take **и** where the regular ending would be **ы**:
«In the instrumental case of the “hard” declension after **ж**, **ч**, **ш**, **щ** and **ц**, the unstressed ending is **-ей** (not **-ой**).»
«In the instrumental case of the “soft” declension (of nouns ending in **-я**) the stressed ending is **-ёй** (not **-ей**).»
«The endings **-у** and **-ат** in the forms **служу** and **служат** are in accordance with the general spelling rule.»
